mintAuthority.summary: XO Cash is an M0-backed Solana extension; base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway, Solana movement relies on M0 portal infrastructure, and the XO mint authority is a Solana account.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing XO Cash depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint.
routeChecks.caps: Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy; cap governance remains with M0 TTG and Registrar governance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. No external admin or module surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders).

controls.label: M0 Solana Portal
controls.capDescription: M0 documents Solana as a spoke deployment bridged from Ethereum; base M supply is governed by Ethereum MinterGateway.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: XO Cash is a Solana extension of M0 M; base M supply remains governed by the Ethereum MinterGateway.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: M0 Solana Portal program is confirmed executable, but token-specific remote-peer config was not independently enumerated.
routeChecks.caps: Effective Solana extension capacity is bounded by the portal route and base M supply, not by an immutable Solana token cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Solana portal/program administration remains under the M0 program-upgrade authority reviewed for this token.

sources.label: M0 on Solana technical deep dive

controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432836017, Portal program mzp1q2j5Hr1QuLC3KFBCAUz5aUckT6qyuZKZ3WJnMmY was executable under BPFLoaderUpgradeable; its ProgramData upgrade authority was 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW. M0 documents that the Portal validates Wormhole messages and mints Solana M backed by M locked in the Ethereum HubPortal.

controls.label: XO Solana mint authority (PDA)

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: XO mint authority is an off-curve PDA derived from the M0 XO extension program with seeds=["mint_authority"].
routeChecks.caps: No immutable token-level mint cap was observed; effective capacity depends on the extension program, portal route, and underlying M supply.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Extension program upgrade authority is the shared M0 Solana EOA; XO extension authorities point to a MoonPay-funded System account where checked.

controls.evidence: At Solana slot 425799131: XO mintAuthority=F4fpAN5ZSFm9QJ5WTWemgnV6ktwwWQS5DPB4m1pCJinu. Ed25519 curve check confirms this address is off-curve (not a keypair) — it is a PDA derived from M0 XO extension program mexteGyWXgUR65XepNKtLJ2H66MmyLWrDSeA1bqzZ4C with seeds=["mint_authority"], nonce=255. PDA derivation verified computationally. Extension program upgrade authority=9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW (funded EOA, shared across all M0 Solana programs). XO Token-2022 extension authorities (pausable, permanentDelegate, transferHook, confidentialTransfer, metadataPointer, freezeAuthority) all point to AgNSjv3CWETjQgcLK5MkTzRSt3KirbrBqGagjv5AKbCR, a funded System program account (MoonPay EOA, 29225720 lamports).

controls.label: M0 Solana upgrade authority keypair
controls.evidence: ProgramData accounts of the M0 XO extension program mexteGyWXgUR65XepNKtLJ2H66MmyLWrDSeA1bqzZ4C (Bb93m5PsfN7LGeKd2LanP3k8MbfdQUSc75rdq5Cg4jAS) and the M0 Solana Portal mzp1q2j5Hr1QuLC3KFBCAUz5aUckT6qyuZKZ3WJnMmY (GBcoKgAkTQ5ZYJM2PzsjhRnDfkwBcgx7hapcAJjrcu5n) both name this address as the BPFLoaderUpgradeable upgrade authority, read 2026-07-20 at current slot. It is a system-owned keypair (on-curve, ~0.45 SOL) — the M0 operations wallet that can upgrade both programs and thereby change XO mint logic.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: MinterGateway confirmed immutable non-proxy. At Solana slot 425799131: XO mintAuthority F4fpAN5ZSFm9QJ5WTWemgnV6ktwwWQS5DPB4m1pCJinu confirmed off-curve PDA of mexteGyWXgUR65XepNKtLJ2H66MmyLWrDSeA1bqzZ4C (seeds=["mint_authority"], nonce=255); extension program upgrade authority=9QpF8a9T... (shared EOA). Extension+freeze authorities confirmed EOA (AgNSjv3CWETj..., funded 29225720 lamports). Null uninitialized = expected for PDAs; off-curve proves it cannot be a free keypair. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: independent M0 governance and program administration can raise the route, M0 validators attest the backing rail, but no evidence reconciles every XO Solana mint path to reserves.
